title: Haunted Factory
description:
Take on the roll of a worker organizing an assembly line, and have chats with the friendly ghost haunting the facility during your breaks.

This game requires the Klango framework to run, and is only available in demo form. The game's own installer runs: it installs the game into Klango's games folder, and offers to install Klango Player 1.31 first if it isn't there. Klango's online service may no longer be running, so Klango Player might not start.
